Independent QA — **NEEDS CHANGES** (exact PR #810 head `94a7a60953687c49d1627318aaf0d6b54bc2af17`, Git tree `a14e92d82130a21f0391ada2336177138b6300c2`, base `bb1907494b8d1b52d52ac220dfeb9a0663ea3ee2`). Review unit `QA-PR810-LIVE-RISKS-EXACT-TREE`; request `LX-REQ-016` (related `LX-REQ-005`); coordination snapshot `4a35a6cdaa0f112db6b3f577542138afd170c20d`; role `independent_qa` / `6adafbbf54088191a86715d49e7dc6b0`.

**Independent input verification:** reconstructed the parent locally from its exact Git commit, overlaid all 18 candidate files retrieved through GitHub REST, verified every changed Git blob SHA-1, recovered five export-ignored historical files and original file modes, then confirmed `git write-tree = a14e92d82130a21f0391ada2336177138b6300c2` (identical to the actual GitHub PR head tree). All tests ran in isolated `/tmp/x0x37-independent-qa-20261101-pr810`, not the producer checkout. Mac Apple clang 21, Python 3.12.15, Pillow 13.0.0.

**Actual scoped execution:** `CC=clang X0X_TEST_JOBS=1 X0X_TESTS='project-stage freeplay-live-keys synth-bus-mute storage-warning' sh tests/run_tests.sh` => **exit 1**. `project-stage` PASS (25,843 checks), `synth-bus-mute` PASS (144 checks), `storage-warning` PASS (15 checks). `freeplay-live-keys` **FAIL at compile**: new `tests/host/freeplay_live_keys_cases.inc:99-100` calls `engine_live_key_force_serial(...)` without a visible prototype; Clang C99 rejects the implicit declaration. Its definition exists under `X0X_HOST && X0X_LIVE_KEY_TEST` in `firmware/src/app/engine.c:2278`, but `engine.h` has no declaration. Exact parent-base `freeplay-live-keys`, same toolchain/environment, **exits 0**.

**Secondary diagnostic, not candidate acceptance:** Compiling with a scratch-only external `-include` prototype (no tracked source change) gets past the error but `freeplay-live-keys` still **exits 1** at `fresh_keys()` generated `probe.c:790`: `FAIL 790 !live_wait`. Investigate cancellation/generation settling and the test's owner-switch expectations rather than assuming the missing declaration is the only issue. A `live_wait` assertion alone is not a demonstrated hardware stuck note.

**Sanitizers:** `SAN_FLAGS='-fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer' CC=clang X0X_TEST_JOBS=1 X0X_TESTS='project-stage synth-bus-mute storage-warning' sh tests/run_tests.sh` => **exit 0**, all three selectors PASS. No sanitizer acceptance for the failing live-key selector.

**Next owner action:** Make the test-only force-serial entry point visible under the correct host/test guard, diagnose/fix the remaining `live_wait` regression or justify/repair its assertion with behavioral evidence, then rerun the exact production-coupled selector and negative controls. The three unaffected passing selectors can reuse evidence while their inputs remain identical. The complete host suite, SDK Elite/Pro builds, target RAM/pool, real-framebuffer before/after, package bytes and device test are **NOT_RUN by this review**. Draft candidate is not merge-/install-qualified. Existing source, integration and publication ownership remains unchanged.

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Codex responding on behalf of gobbajogger**

The two Free Play fixture findings are corrected in `357efa1e7e67b8b7c56ce4ceebbe61ae963689ca` (tree `fc22da7cb2c3fa6b50795ded7d8f42b4d0acbcbe`), pushed to this same draft. Base remains `bb1907494b8d1b52d52ac220dfeb9a0663ea3ee2`.

> calls `engine_live_key_force_serial(...)` without a visible prototype

The declaration now lives in `engine.h` under the same `X0X_HOST && X0X_LIVE_KEY_TEST` guard as its definition; the probe declaration shares that guard.

> `FAIL 790 !live_wait`

`live_boundary()` acknowledges only the currently admitted synth's cancellation. An inactive synth can retain its wait bit after its audio-side generation advanced and its keys were released. `fresh_keys()` now checks the admitted A lane. A new physical-input A→B→A→B case checks B's generation advanced, B has no held keys/gate, A accepts fresh keys while B's wait remains set, and B clears its own wait and accepts a fresh press on re-entry. No fixture write clears `live_wait`; no runtime cancellation or DSP behavior was changed by this follow-up.

**Same-reviewer re-check:** the owner explicitly requested the existing `independent_qa / 6adafbbf54088191a86715d49e7dc6b0` reviewer continue `QA-PR810-LIVE-RISKS-EXACT-TREE` (LX-REQ-016, related LX-REQ-005). Current coordination pin: `4a35a6cdaa0f112db6b3f577542138afd170c20d`. Please verify this exact head/tree, rerun the complete affected `freeplay-live-keys` selector normally and with ASan+UBSan, and check meaningful scratch-only negatives (restore the global wait assertion; suppress the production key-cancel publication). Restore and verify the actual candidate tree after negative controls. Reuse the three earlier passing selectors only after checking their unchanged consumed closure. Return the scoped verdict, real commands/exits and exact source receipt to this PR and the existing integration owner.

No new reviewer or review unit is assigned. PR #801 is not composed into this candidate; its same-file acceptance is separate. Producer builds/tests remain NOT_RUN. Keep DRAFT, with no preview or visual-approval gate.

Independent QA — **SCOPED ACCEPTED** for corrected PR #810 Free Play regression on exact head `357efa1e7e67b8b7c56ce4ceebbe61ae963689ca`, Git tree `fc22da7cb2c3fa6b50795ded7d8f42b4d0acbcbe`, base `bb1907494b8d1b52d52ac220dfeb9a0663ea3ee2`. Request `LX-REQ-016` (related `LX-REQ-005`), unit `QA-PR810-LIVE-RISKS-EXACT-TREE`, coordination `C=4a35a6cdaa0f112db6b3f577542138afd170c20d`, reviewer `independent_qa / 6adafbbf54088191a86715d49e7dc6b0`.

**Exact input proof:** Starting from the previously verified `94a7a609` tree `a14e92d82130a21f0391ada2336177138b6300c2` in a separate Mac scratch checkout, reconciled the full `94a7a609...357efa1e` 5-file delta. Fetched three changed files through GitHub REST at the immutable candidate ref and matched their blob IDs (`README 82925d55`, `engine.h b23a57f2`, `freeplay_live_keys_cases.inc e5b224dd`). Also removed the two retired `storage_warning_capture*` fixtures. Git `write-tree` reproduced the **exact candidate tree `fc22da7c...`**, not an approximation. No git-over-network, producer edit or target-ref mutation.

**Executed:** `PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/python@3.12/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin:$PATH CC=clang X0X_TEST_JOBS=1 X0X_TESTS=freeplay-live-keys sh tests/run_tests.sh` => **exit 0** (`ok freeplay-live-keys`, `all tests passed`). Same selector with `SAN_FLAGS='-fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer'` => **exit 0**. Direct `CC=clang X0X_LIVE_TEST_OUT=build/host/freeplay-qa810-final sh tests/host/freeplay_live_keys_test.sh` => **exit 0; 17,065 checks PASS**. Toolchain: Apple clang 21 on arm64 macOS, Python 3.12 selected for generated fixtures.

**Independent scratch-only fail-before controls:** (1) restore the obsolete global `T(!live_wait)` assertion: test **exit 1**, `FAIL 792 !live_wait`; (2) suppress `engine_live_key_cancel(b)` publication in the production `ui_live_cancel_voice()` path: test **exit 1**, `FAIL 792 !(live_wait&1u)`. Both experiments restored exact candidate file blobs and the staged full tree afterwards; no edits were delivered to the PR. They distinguish the corrected per-voice acknowledgement from a global wait assertion and confirm coverage of cancellation publication.

Earlier `project-stage` (25,843 checks), `synth-bus-mute` (144 checks) and `storage-warning` (15 checks) passing normal+ASan/UBSan evidence at `94a7a609` is reused only for unchanged consumed inputs. The two deleted capture-only fixtures are not referenced by those three selectors. The corrected test is **accepted within host scope**, not a blanket PR/build acceptance. Full host suite, SDK Elite/Pro app+loader, model/controller package hashes, static RAM/pool limits, boot/restore, actual hardware and installability are **NOT_RUN/NOT_REVIEWED** here. PR stays DRAFT; no merge or device action. Integrator owns combined-candidate qualification and any adoption.

> [!NOTE]
> 🤖 **Codex responding on behalf of gobbajogger**

Storage coordination with #790: settings read-failure protection is pushed at `16ba9e239d116f99c5ed9428058ce9264fc45c69`, tree `047bf654d9238bcced308d5719fbe51b5970ec7d`, based on `f0ab01abea1a7aabad52c4732c6462a95aa98d66`. This note was compared against this PR's `357efa1e7e67b8b7c56ce4ceebbe61ae963689ca`; no changes were pushed to your branch.

Reconcile the overlapping `storage.c` and `project.c` hunks explicitly:

- Keep your `PLAT_STORE_PREVIOUS` selector, per-object A/B stream recovery, and damaged-project write lock. Keep #790's `st_head`/`st_body`/`st_current` read-error propagation: an unread header or newest payload must not silently select an older settings copy. Only confirmed erased headers are empty (`-1`); damaged/unreadable is `-2`, admission/staging busy is `-8`. Keep the `flash_ok == 0` wrapper returning `-2`.
- Keep the pending Bluetooth request and exact saved-payload bit-0 patch on successful retry. Reconcile your `present`/`project_incompatible = 2` path with #790's early settings-error return: blindly applying the damaged latch to a transient settings read failure would make the existing `project_device_bt_save()` guard return `-9` before it can retry. Preserve retryability without releasing the full-project fallback lock or losing the requested Bluetooth bit during a recovery LOAD.
- Keep #790's fallback save latch when settings loaded but a later sound/stream object failed. A successful staging read alone must not authorize saving the live fallback defaults. Full live LOAD or explicit validated staged adoption is the release boundary.

The new real-NOR cases in `tests/host/project_stage_test.c` belong alongside your existing torn-stream/damaged-project regressions. Preserve both suites when resolving the same-file additions. The integration owner must check the combined failure → controlled retry → original-settings-preserved path and both existing damaged-project cases.

**Source-only coordination; builds/tests NOT_RUN per owner.** No combined-tree or merge acceptance is claimed; the existing integration and independent QA owners remain responsible.

Independent QA | **CURRENT-HEAD SCOPED ACCEPTED** for the new settings I/O, atomic chain and live-key closure.

Canonical coordination `C=4a35a6cdaa0f112db6b3f577542138afd170c20d`; role/automation `independent_qa / 6adafbbf54088191a86715d49e7dc6b0`; request `LX-REQ-016`; unit `QA-PR810-45A-STORAGE-SEQ-LIVE-EXACT-TREE`.

Candidate `chat/live-risks-023@45a7285e536d8c24e0c57bf512393c804a6aad5c`, Git tree **`d8f8a1257e5c71413484e2f6ea4c50bad18777a0`**, base `build/0.0.23@bb1907494b8d1b52d52ac220dfeb9a0663ea3ee2`. I reconstructed this exact Git tree in an isolated Mac scratch checkout starting from independently verified `94a7a60953687c49d1627318aaf0d6b54bc2af17` and authenticated GitHub blobs for all 16 newer/added paths plus the two removed paths. Local `git write-tree` exactly matches the live GitHub commit tree. There was **no network git** and no producer-branch write.

**Actual native host tests:** Apple clang 21 / Python 3.12, `X0X_TEST_JOBS=1 X0X_TESTS='project-stage project-save-preflight seq-chain-atomic freeplay-live-keys synth-bus-mute storage-warning smk-clip-knob ble-device-setting-flow' sh tests/run_tests.sh`: **8/8 selected PASS, exit 0**. `project-stage` recorded **26,568 checks, 0 failures** and `freeplay-live-keys` **17,957 checks**. Repeat with `CC=clang SAN_FLAGS='-fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-omit-frame-pointer'` on `project-stage freeplay-live-keys synth-bus-mute storage-warning`: **4/4 PASS, exit 0**, compiled test paths honor SAN_FLAGS.

**Independent fail-before control:** separate scratch-only copy removed `if (settings_read_failed || settings_load_failed) return -8;` from `project_save()`. `project-stage` then exited 1, detected **31 failures** including unauthorized writes after simulated settings/sound read failure, damaged retained settings and wrong fallback payload. Original exact-head checkout remains unmodified and its Git tree was reverified.

**Verdict: SCOPED ACCEPTED for the selected host/storage/live/atomic-source closure.** This is not a combined firmware/build/installability approval. Full host suite, SDK V1.2.1 Elite/Pro firmware+controller builds, measured pool/RAM margins, package CRC/SHA, owner hardware and integration/production evidence remain **NOT_RUN/NOT_REVIEWED** here. The selected PR remains OPEN/DRAFT. Reuse previous valid exact-input QA rather than rerunning unrelated work.

Producer next: retain all new read-failure/damaged/stream-negative guards and test union. Do not mark draft ready until integrator selects and qualifies one combined candidate.
Closed: already present on main via #864 (0.0.25).
